arguments.summary: Fixed-evidence synthesis: AI-infrastructure demand anchors permit conditional operating cases and explicit EPS/P/E sensitivities for NVDA and MU. The company P/E ranges have no empirical/rule-based selection anchor, MU’s FY2026 Q4 outcome is absent, and QQQ has no comparable operating scenario. No directional 63-session preference versus QQQ is established.

claims.text: NVDA reported FY2027 first-half GAAP diluted EPS of $4.85. Q2 Data Center revenue was $89.0bn and Q3 revenue guidance was $108.0bn ±2%, with no assumed China Data Center compute revenue. Broad Q3 delivery and sustained AI-platform deployment through the 14-week Q4 are the base-bridge predicates; customer deployment/capital, supply, or policy friction could defer conversion.

NVDA FY2027 (53 weeks) sensitivity stipulates GAAP EPS/P-E cases of $9.50/17x, $10.50/22x, and $11.50/27x. Against the September 18 split-adjusted close, calculated bear/base/bull changes are -27.34%/+3.93%/+39.69%. Bull gain exceeds absolute bear loss by 12.35 points solely as a property of selected inputs, not valuation skew, likelihood, fair value, or attractiveness.

MU reported FY2026 nine-month GAAP diluted EPS of $41.40, guided Q4 GAAP EPS to $30.73 ±$1.00, and reported high-volume HBM4 shipments. AI-memory demand/pricing and margin conversion are the near-term bridge; FY2026 ended September 3 but Q4 results were scheduled for September 30, leaving the annual outcome provisional in this fixed record.

MU’s provisional ended-FY2026 (53 weeks) sensitivity stipulates GAAP EPS/P-E cases of $70.50/10x, $72.50/14x, and $74.00/18x. Against the September 18 split-adjusted close, calculated bear/base/bull changes are -30.60%/-0.08%/+31.13%. The 0.53-point excess of selected bull gain over absolute bear loss is near symmetry in this mechanical grid, not evidence of a valuation distribution, likelihood, or preference.

Micron’s disclosed Section 232/301 investigation risk supports only a conditional channel: tariffs or trade restrictions applicable to its products, materials, equipment, or customers could raise costs, cause delays, or weaken demand and earnings conversion. The record does not map covered Micron exposure or quantify an impact on the Q4 bridge.

Over matched completed 63-session windows through September 18, NVDA outperformed QQQ by 8.08 percentage points, MU underperformed QQQ by 7.83 points, and QQQ underperformed SPY by 4.59 points. MU’s 63-session realized volatility was 89.56%, versus 39.63% for NVDA and 20.85% for QQQ. These are historical path/risk observations, not causal or forward-performance evidence.

QQQ reported 103 holdings and a sponsor aggregate P/E of 30.08 as of August 31; its September 18 equity holdings reported NVDA at 8.535228% and MU at 5.012336%. This establishes diversified but material dated issuer overlap, not current holdings, a direct-company valuation equivalent, or a quantified policy sensitivity.

No NVDA-, MU-, or QQQ-preference is established for the 63-session mandate. NVDA’s historical relative-strength lead is not a forward valuation framework; MU’s annual bridge is provisional and its longer path lagged QQQ; and QQQ’s dated aggregate metric and diversified structure cannot be converted into comparable company EPS/P-E cases. This is an evidence-limit conclusion, not an assertion of equal prospective returns.

gaps.description: No observed company P/E history, consensus, or documented range-selection rule supports the stipulated company P/E ranges. Sensitivity arithmetic remains valid, but case labels and asymmetry cannot establish fair value, valuation skew, or preference.

MU’s FY2026 Q4 result is absent; only its scheduled September 30 release and prior guidance are supplied. This limits precision of its provisional ended-year bridge without invalidating its explicitly guidance-conditioned sensitivity.
No current policy verification or quantified issuer/fund exposure is supplied. Dated disclosures support conditional policy channels, not current legal applicability or an EPS/fund-loss estimate.
No current rates/inflation series or comparable QQQ operating scenario is supplied. Historical market behavior and dated fund structure alone do not establish a three-month relative preference.

assumptions: All company EPS and P/E inputs in e56/e57 are transparent GAAP constant-share stress assumptions, not observed multiples, consensus, probabilities, forecasts, or fair values.

Multiple cases mechanically pair weaker/base/stronger stipulated earnings conversion with lower/mid/higher stipulated multiples; no empirical company-multiple record or calibrated range-selection rule is supplied.
QQQ holdings and aggregate valuation are dated sponsor disclosures, not current holdings or equivalent company metrics.
arguments.counter_thesis: AI deployment or memory pricing could exceed stipulated operating cases and support a higher multiple, while operating delivery could coincide with multiple compression or policy/infrastructure disruption. The evidence assigns no probability or magnitude to either transmission.

review_conditions.description: Review NVDA’s next results against the $108.0bn ±2% Q3 revenue outlook, margin/opex guidance, and Q4 demand/supply commentary. A material shortfall weakens the base residual bridge; delivery plus sustained deployment supports retesting it.

Review MU’s Q4 result against $30.73 ±$1.00 GAAP EPS guidance. A result below, within, or above that range respectively changes the bear/base/bull residual classification and replaces the provisional FY2026 estimate.
Review QQQ only upon a new dated sponsor holdings/characteristics release. Material weight or methodology changes would alter the dated overlap and aggregate-valuation description.

task-9-o1-multiple-range-rationale.reason: This synthesis does not use the selected grid asymmetry as valuation skew or relative attractiveness. No empirical company-multiple history or documented range-selection rule is supplied to anchor the numerical P/E ranges.

NVDA.thesis: AI-platform demand, Q3 guidance, and first-half reported EPS support a conditional FY2027 delivery bridge; NVDA also led QQQ over the supplied 63-session path. Customer infrastructure/capital, supply commitments, and export/supply-chain channels can delay conversion.
NVDA.counter_thesis: Delivery does not ensure the stipulated 22x multiple. Infrastructure/capital constraints, China-related policy gates, or Taiwan/South Korea supply disruption could impair conversion, with neither magnitude nor likelihood measured.
assumptions: FY2027 is the disclosed 53-week period from 2026-01-26 to 2027-01-31; Q4 is 14 weeks.
EPS residuals use a constant diluted-share approximation; P/E cases are unanchored stress assumptions.

review_conditions.description: Compare next results with Q3 revenue guidance and subsequent Q4 demand/supply commentary; a shortfall weakens the base bridge, while delivery supports retesting it.
A completed split-adjusted close below frozen 214.2726 weakens the intermediate-trend component of NVDA’s historical relative-path observation.

NVDA.valuation: FY2027 is the sourced 53-week period 2026-01-26 to 2027-01-31. Reported first-half GAAP diluted EPS was $4.85. Stipulated bear/base/bull annual GAAP EPS of $9.50/$10.50/$11.50 leave constant-share residual EPS of $4.65/$5.65/$6.65; base assumes broad Q3-guidance delivery and sustained demand through the 14-week Q4. Q3 guidance supplies revenue/margin/opex, not EPS. At stipulated 17x/22x/27x P/E, calculated changes are -27.34%/+3.93%/+39.69%. Base break-even is $10.1032 EPS holding 22x fixed, or 21.1686x holding $10.50 EPS fixed. Bull gain exceeds absolute bear loss by 12.35 points solely because of selected joint EPS/multiple inputs. These cases have no empirical multiple-range anchor, probabilities, or fair-value implication.
NVDA.etf_lookthrough: QQQ held NVDA at a dated 8.535228% on September 18; it is not a current fund-exposure estimate.

business.qualification: Deployment, supply, and customer-capital constraints can defer conversion.

policy_exposure.conclusion: China exclusion and overseas-supply reliance identify transmission channels.
policy_exposure.qualification: Legal status and financial impact are unquantified.

MU.thesis: Record Q3 results, Q4 guidance, and HBM4 shipments support a conditional AI-memory demand/pricing and margin-conversion bridge. The base residual is within guidance, but Q4 remained unreported in this fixed record; MU lagged QQQ over 63 sessions with substantially higher realized volatility.
MU.counter_thesis: A memory demand/pricing or margin reversal, Q4 miss, or applicable trade disruption could undermine the bridge; even in-line EPS may not preserve the stipulated P/E. Direct policy applicability and impact are unmeasured.
assumptions: FY2026 is a 53-week period ending 2026-09-03 and is a provisional historical estimate pending Q4 results.
EPS residuals are constant-share approximations; P/E inputs are unanchored stress assumptions.

review_conditions.description: Compare reported Q4 GAAP EPS with $30.73 ±$1.00; this resolves the provisional annual bridge and changes its residual-case classification.
A completed split-adjusted close below frozen 927.2569 weakens the recent-rebound reading and reinforces the 63-session lag/high-path-risk interpretation.

MU.valuation: FY2026 is the sourced 53-week period 2025-08-29 to 2026-09-03. It ended before the cutoff, but Q4 results were scheduled for September 30, making this provisional historical estimation rather than forward annual earnings. Reported nine-month GAAP diluted EPS was $41.40. Stipulated annual GAAP EPS of $70.50/$72.50/$74.00 leave $29.10/$31.10/$32.60 residual EPS versus guided Q4 GAAP EPS of $30.73 ±$1.00—below/within/above that range. At stipulated 10x/14x/18x P/E, calculated changes are -30.60%/-0.08%/+31.13%. Base break-even is $72.5571 EPS holding 14x fixed, or 14.0110x holding $72.50 EPS fixed. Bull gain exceeds absolute bear loss by 0.53 points, a near-symmetric mechanical result of selected inputs. Joint earnings/multiple risk and no empirical multiple-range anchor preclude a preference signal.

QQQ.thesis: QQQ provides dated diversified exposure across roughly 103 holdings while retaining material direct NVDA and MU overlap. It was above supplied moving averages but lagged SPY over the matched 63-session window; its aggregate sponsor P/E cannot become a company-style scenario.
QQQ.counter_thesis: Diversification does not insulate QQQ from shared AI, policy, or discount-rate shocks, and the packet provides no comparable fund operating scenario or factor sensitivity.
assumptions: Holdings are the September 18 sponsor view and aggregate P/E is the August 31 sponsor metric.
No synthetic ETF earnings scenario or company-style valuation ranking is inferred.
